suspicions.source_quote: For a pending order, each item can be modified to an available new item of the same product but of different product option. There cannot be any change of product types, e.g. modify shirt to shoe.
suspicions.why_error: The agent is attempting to modify a T-shirt from size XXL black cotton crew neck (item_id: 3799046073) to size L red cotton v-neck (item_id: 3234800602). While these are the same product type (T-Shirt), the agent is changing the style from 'crew neck' to 'v-neck', which could be considered a different product option. However, the policy doesn't explicitly prohibit changing style, so this is not a clear violation.
